title: Wendell and the Radiators
author: Noor Brightwater
blurb: Tamsin Ishikawa, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
